2_lowerFrontCornerChamferable.parameter: build_rear_pack.py CHAMFER (cx, cz): plane through (x -19-cx, z -44) and (x -19, z -44+cz), full width
limits: cx <= 4.9 keeps the cut in front of the USB opening (x -23.9)
cz * (1 - 2/cx) <= 1.2 for cx > 2 keeps the cut below the bay floor (z -42.8) behind the plate (x < -21); for cx <= 2 the cut stays in the plate slab and cz may reach 9
the lower OpenRB pads (z >= -42.25 at x -24.8..-21) are then automatically clear
